name: NGC 1309 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1309, a face-on spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: n1309-hubble
story: A spiral galaxy turned face-on toward us, home to two much-studied supernovae: SN 2002fk, a perfect example of a Type Ia supernova, and SN 2012Z, a renegade Type Iax. Hubble has turned its attention here several times.

claims.text: N1309 is a target of Hubble program 12880, 'The Hubble Constant: Completing HST's Legacy with WFC3'
NGC 1309 is a face-on spiral galaxy
NGC 1309 hosted SN 2002fk in 2002 and SN 2012Z in 2012
SN 2002fk was a perfect example of a Type Ia supernova
SN 2012Z was a renegade, classified as a Type Iax supernova
Hubble has observed NGC 1309 several times
